kjv: I will cleanse their blood [that] I have not cleansed (KJV 3:21)
mine: I will declare innocent their blood, which I had not declared innocent
note: niqqah means "acquit/hold innocent" (the shed blood is declared innocent, i.e. avenged); KJV's "cleanse" is literal-sounding but obscure, and the LXX reads "avenge".
